title: Kubernetes Triage Plan
description: A structured plan for triaging a misbehaving Kubernetes workload — symptom, first diagnostic action, fix approach, and hygiene facts — so this runbook's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/kubernetes_debugging_runbook_audit.mjs.

symptom.description: The observed failure shape, per the pod-status decoding table.

firstAction.description: The first step of the triage. Diagnostic reads should come before any mutation.

usedPreviousLogs.description: True if the plan reads kubectl logs --previous. Mandatory for CrashLoopBackOff — the current instance hasn't crashed yet.

fixApproach.description: How the fix will be applied. kubectl-exec-hotfix creates an undocumented snowflake and fails the audit.

memoryRequestsSet.description: True if the affected containers set resources.requests.memory.

memoryLimitsSet.description: True if the affected containers set resources.limits.memory.

livenessSameAsReadiness.description: True if the liveness probe hits the same dependency-checking endpoint as readiness — the healthy-pod-killer anti-pattern.

hpaTargetsHaveRequests.description: True if every container targeted by the HPA declares resources.requests (required for percentage-utilization math).

networkPolicyAudited.description: True if kubectl get netpol was reviewed for deny-by-default policies affecting the namespace.

imageTag.description: Whether the deployment pins an immutable image tag/digest or floats on latest.

restartAlertingConfigured.description: True if an alert exists on kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total (with OOMKilled split out).
